gloss: the dark part of the eye; iris and pupil

definitions.gloss: the dark part of the eye; iris and pupil
definitions.explanation: The coloured centre of the eye, the iris and pupil together. Most Japanese eyes are dark brown, so everyday speech calls this part simply the black eye.

examples.japanese: {黒目|くろめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{黒目|くろめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きらきら→きらきら：05159_kirakira⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The baby's dark eyes are sparkling.

examples.japanese: {黒目|くろめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦コンタクトレンズ→コンタクトレンズ：17011_kontakutorenzu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Contact lenses that make the irises look bigger are popular with young people.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {黒目|くろめ}がち: with large dark irises, a look admired in faces and in portraits
- {黒目|くろめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: to have large irises

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白目|しろめ}→白目：33544_shirome⟧: the white of the eye
- ⟦{瞳|ひとみ}→瞳：02252_hitomi⟧: the pupil; in writing, a softer word for the eyes themselves
- {虹彩|こうさい}: the iris, in medicine and biology
